title: Onboard Pulsa-11B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add Pulsa-11B v1.0 to the model registry with complete metadata, supported performance profiles for our serving runtime, and automated changelog/release-note generation so model onboarding surfaces in release logs automatically.

What this PR does:
- Adds canonical metadata (model card fields, weights provenance, supported quantizations) for pulsa-11b v1.0.
- Adds performance profiles (latency/throughput) for common deployment targets (A100-40GB, A10G, T4) across representative batch/seq configs.
- Hooks onboarding into changelog automation: updates the onboarding script to append model release notes to registry CHANGELOG.md and to emit structured release metadata used by the docs site.
- Adds small docs page with model summary and usage notes.

Checklist: [x] metadata YAML and model card added; [x] perf profile JSONs added and validated against perf schema; [x] changelog automation integrated and unit-tested; [x] docs page added; [x] CI green across unit/perf validations.

Commits summary: 1) Add metadata and model card for pulsa-11b v1.0 2) Add perf profiles (A100/A10G/T4) and perf validation tests 3) Changlog automation: onboarding script updates and tests 4) Docs: model page and cross-links 5) Fix review feedback (naming, additional perf case)

Files changed (high level): models/pulsa-11b/v1.0/metadata.yaml; models/pulsa-11b/v1.0/model_card.md; perf_profiles/pulsa-11b-v1.0/a100-40gb.json; perf_profiles/pulsa-11b-v1.0/a10g.json; perf_profiles/pulsa-11b-v1.0/t4.json; scripts/onboard_model.py (changelog automation hooks); scripts/tests/test_perf_profiles.py; docs/models/pulsa-11b.md; CHANGELOG.md (automated append).

Notes on performance profiles: Each profile contains target tokens/sec, median p50 latency (ms) at seq lengths [64,512,1024], memory estimates, and recommended quantization. Representative numbers captured from internal perf lab (single-replica; continuous batching off for p50): A100-40GB: 2400 tok/s (seq64), p50 12ms (seq64), supports int8/ptq; A10G: 1100 tok/s (seq64), p50 28ms; T4: 420 tok/s (seq64), p50 72ms. Profiles include per-device kernel selection hints and a short note on expected throughput with batching enabled.

Changelog automation: onboarding now writes a structured entry under CHANGELOG.md with format: "Pulsa-11B v1.0 — onboarded; perf profiles added; recommended config: A100-40GB int8" and emits a JSON metadata file under releases/2026-02-18/pulsa-11b-v1.0.json consumed by the docs pipeline. The onboarding script has a --dry-run option exercised in CI.

Testing and CI: Unit tests added for perf profile schema validation and for the changelog writer. CI runs: unit, lint, perf-smoke (simulator). All checks passed on the final push.

Review and discussion (short): See review_comments field for thread excerpts.

Merge: Squash merged into main after approvals from Diego and Liang. Release notes generated and staged for docs build.
